load_state_dict: load a PyTorch model state dict from a checkpoint file with EMA support
load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint file and apply the state dict to a PyTorch model
resume_checkpoint: resume training by restoring model, optimizer, and loss scaler state from a checkpoint
load_pretrained: load pretrained weights into a Timesformer model with channel and classifier adaptation
build_model_with_cfg: build a Timesformer model with optional pretrained weights and feature extraction wrapper
